summary: Contract Addendum No. 1, dated 10 July 2026, between Prince Alpherson A. Wagan doing business as ADVO Web Development Services and FourlinQ Windows and Doors represented by Ms. Imie. It modifies the original 27 February 2026 website agreement, restating the ₱75,000 total investment (including ₱15,000 for the AI chatbot) against which ₱12,000 was paid on 27 February 2026, and fixes the ₱63,000 balance as payable before ownership and source transfer. It adds a separate AI chatbot maintenance fee of ₱3,000 per month beginning one year after the transfer of ownership, and restates that general website maintenance is free for the first 12 months and ₱5,000 per year thereafter. The addendum prevails over the original where they conflict; signature blocks are blank.

fact.claim: Contract Addendum No. 1 was entered into on July 10, 2026 between Prince Alpherson A. Wagan doing business as ADVO Web Development Services and FourlinQ Windows and Doors represented by Ms. Imie.
fact.quote: **FourlinQ Windows and Doors**, represented by **Ms. Imie** (hereinafter referred to as the "Client").

fact.claim: The original website agreement is dated February 27, 2026 with a ₱75,000.00 total investment, against which a ₱12,000.00 down payment was paid on February 27, 2026.
fact.quote: concerning the total project investment of ₱75,000.00, against which a ₱12,000.00  down payment was paid on February 27, 2026.

fact.claim: The ₱75,000 total includes a ₱15,000.00 fee for developing and integrating the AI chatbot.
fact.quote: the ₱75,000.00  total project investment includes a ₱15,000.00  fee specifically allocated for the development and integration of the AI Chatbot;

fact.claim: The original agreement set a ₱5,000.00 general annual maintenance fee after the first year but did not define the chatbot's ongoing costs, which this addendum clarifies.
fact.quote: the Original Agreement stipulates a general annual maintenance fee of ₱5,000.00 commencing after the first year, but does not explicitly define the ongoing maintenance and operational costs specifically required for the AI Chatbot;

fact.claim: The client must pay the ₱63,000.00 remaining balance before ownership, source files and codebases are transferred.
fact.quote: The client shall remit the remaining balance of ₱63,000.00 prior to the complete transfer of ownership, source files, and codebases, completing the ₱75,000.00 total project investment.

fact.claim: A separate AI chatbot maintenance fee of ₱3,000.00 per month applies, starting one year after the complete transfer of ownership.
fact.quote: a separate maintenance fee of ₱3,000.00 per month will apply. This fee shall commence one year after the complete transfer of ownership, source files, and codebases.

fact.claim: General website maintenance is free for the first 12 months and then costs the standard ₱5,000 per year.
fact.quote: Upon the conclusion of the first year (12 months), the Client shall be subject to the standard annual maintenance fee of **5,000 PHP**.

fact.claim: All other terms of the original agreement remain in force, and the addendum prevails in any conflict.
fact.quote: In the event of any conflict between the terms of the Original Agreement and this Addendum, the terms of this Addendum shall prevail.

fact.claim: The signature blocks for ADVO Web Development Services and FourlinQ Windows and Doors are blank in the Drive copy.
